【原视频简介】
GLM 5.3 Flash is here, and I put its coding and agent abilities through a brutal test. This review covers benchmarks, pricing, coding performance, OpenRouter access, and the strange OX-Alpha connection.

Was OX-Alpha on OpenRouter and OpenCode actually GLM 5.3 Flash? I compare GLM 5.3 vs 5.3 Flash, look at the GLM 5.3 Flash benchmarks, coding agent performance, weights, HuggingFace availability, and GLM 5.3 price. We also test GLM 5.3 Flash against OX-Alpha and discuss how it compares with models like Kimi K3.
